feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Dems have edge in midterms, poll shows. And, Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to close
entry.summary: Polls are showing that Democrats have a clear advantage heading into the midterms, but that doesn't tell the whole story. And, today, a mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. is set to close.

entry.title: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
entry.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

entry.title: A history of presidents naming things after themselves (It's short. They rarely do)
entry.summary: While Trump pushes to get his name on the Kennedy Center and other public sites, history shows that sitting presidents have almost always avoided putting their brands on government assets.

entry.title: With 4 weeks to go, a look at where November's big races stand
entry.summary: Election Day is four weeks away and people are already voting in the 2026 midterms. Where do things stand in the big races across the country?

entry.title: What challenges lie ahead for the Democratic Party as midterms approach
entry.summary: Democrats are feeling optimistic ahead of the midterms, but what challenges remain? NPR's A Martinez asks Devan Barber, who leads the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee.

entry.title: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
entry.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View, accusing it of being unfair.

entry.title: Democrats' advantage is clear with less than a month to go in the midterm elections
entry.summary: President Trump is facing low approval ratings, and voters are blaming him for rising costs. Republicans are likely to pay the price at the ballot box next month.

entry.title: Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey's new Pentagon roles raise ethics worries
entry.summary: Musk's company, SpaceX, and Luckey's company Anduril, could potentially benefit from recommendations made in the study about future autonomous weapon systems.

entry.title: As Trump focuses the FBI on immigration, counterintelligence is falling behind
entry.summary: The cuts come as a consequence of President Trump and FBI Director Kash Patel's focus on violent crime and immigration, leaving other priorities understaffed.

entry.title: Democrats need to reel in more men. These Mainers say the party needs better bait
entry.summary: Democrats are trying to win back male voters ahead of the midterms. In Maine, some fly fishermen say frustration with both parties is shaping their votes.
